text.p: Ergobank launched a new payroll account - Ergo Pay - designed for private and public sector employees whose salaries will be automatically deposited in the account, it said.
"Finance ministry employees will be the first to start receiving their salary through banks via Dias SA," Ergo Bank said.
Its new deposit account will have a 300,000 drachma overdraft feature and allow free use of Ergo-24 debit card in its 125 ATMs.
Ergo Pay accounts may also obtain an ErgoCard Visa with the annual fee waived for the first year, the bank said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
